claim.summary: For a finite list of real coordinate pairs, pointwise residual evidence, pointwise positive-gap evidence, δ positivity, c nonnegativity, and the explicit scalar bound c > B/(2δ) imply shifted squared-modulus dominance for every coordinate in the list.
inputs: forall p in coords, residual a b p <= B
forall p in coords, δ <= a - p.1
claim.checklist_form: CoordinateEnvelopeChecklist c a b B δ coords implies the same dominance
claim.conclusion: forall p in coords, shiftedSqMod c p.1 p.2 < shiftedSqMod c a b

proves: pointwise residual evidence can be consumed directly
pointwise positive-gap evidence can be consumed directly
explicit c bound c > B/(2δ) suffices for shifted dominance over a finite coordinate list
bundled checklist implies the same finite-coordinate shifted dominance
does_not_prove: that any coordinate is an eigenvalue
that the coordinate list is a matrix spectrum
actual spectrum extraction from a matrix
construction of B from a matrix spectrum
construction of δ from a matrix spectral gap
strict spectral-abscissa hypothesis for a matrix eigenvalue
that a strict-abscissa eigenvalue of a real matrix is real
